public_rationale: American Compute's compilation, updated October 17, 2026, states that no GPU-backed loan had been publicly foreclosed [e1]. This does not establish whether ten to fifteen qualifying data-center loan defaults occurred, because it addresses public foreclosures on GPU-backed loans [e1]. The compilation establishes neither the required default cluster nor a financing-market response caused by it [e1]. It therefore leaves the forecast unresolved [e1].
limitations: The compilation is not a complete, deduplicated register of qualifying loan defaults.
Public foreclosure records do not cover every default, and the evidence does not rule out undisclosed private-loan defaults.
The evidence does not establish a market response attributable to the specified default cluster.
The forecast specifies no deadline, loan-size threshold, clustering period, response lag or numerical definition of 'panic'.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Defaults on just ten or fifteen data center loans would be all it takes to send the industry into a panic, unlike the hundreds of thousands of subprime loan defaults that triggered the financial crisis.
conditions: if ten or fifteen data center loans default

statement.excerpt: This is the data center equivalent of subprime loans defaulting, except instead of hundreds of thousands of loans being the trigger, all it takes is ten or fifteen of them to send the industry into a panic.

from_speaker: send the industry into a panic
our_interpretation: The antecedent is a cluster of ten to fifteen defaults on substantial AI data center loans of the kind discussed in the surrounding text.
Count distinct defaulted loan facilities, not lenders, missed installments or repeated reports of the same default.
The plain reading of panic is broad, abrupt financial distress across data center financing, visible in debt repricing and curtailed financing availability.
The subprime comparison frames the forecast; it does not supply a separately precise historical default-count claim.
No deadline, cluster duration or response lag is specified.
criteria.support_condition: A documented cluster of ten to fifteen qualifying loan defaults is followed by broad, sharp repricing or a financing freeze, with evidence that those defaults triggered the disruption.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented qualifying cluster occurs and financing remains broadly orderly through the immediate market response and a meaningful subsequent financing period.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Verify a cluster of ten to fifteen distinct qualifying loan defaults. Use dated credit prices, issuance volumes, financing records and causal reporting to establish whether those defaults triggered broad, abrupt financing disruption or financing remained broadly orderly through the immediate response and a meaningful subsequent financing period.
